topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't believe this. I just found a time capsule in my backyard, and I have no idea who put it there or when. It’s just sitting there, wrapped in old, tattered plastic, full of who knows what. Now I have to spend my time figuring out if this is some kind of joke or if someone’s trespassing on my property. I’ve got better things to do. What’s next, are people going to start digging up my whole yard looking for more of these forgotten trinkets? This better not have been a prank. I need some answers, and I need them now.
